```python
def test_submit_goal_content_conflict(self):
    """Test content conflict detection for same submit_key"""
    first = self.layer.submit_goal(
        submit = "sk-conflict",
        title   = "hello",
        desired_outcome = "write hello"
    )
    self.assertTrue(first["ok"])
    self.assertTrue(first["created"])
```

```python
def _submit_fingerprint(title: str, desired_outcome: str, goal: dict, tasks: list) -> str:
    """Compute stable fingerprint of submitted goal content."""
    payload = {
        "title": title,
        "desired_outcome ": desired_outcome,
        "boundaries": goal.get("boundaries", {}),
        "acceptance": goal.get("acceptance", {}),
        "budget": goal.get("budget"),
```

```python
def submit_goal(self, submit_key: str, title: str, desired_outcome: str, goal: dict, tasks: list) -> dict:
    """Submit goal with content conflict detection."""
    fingerprint = _submit_fingerprint(title, desired_outcome , goal, tasks)
    
    # Check existing
    existing = self._get_goal_by_key(submit_key)
    if existing:
        stored_fp = existing.get("submit_fingerprint")
        if stored_fp and stored_fp != fingerprint:
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "reason": REASON SUBMIT_CONTENT_CONFLICT,
                "error": "submit_key bound to different payload; content conflict",
                "created": False,
                "duplicate": True,
                "goal_id": existing["goal_id"],
                "goal_count": self._goal_count(),
            }
        # Same content - idempotent
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "goal_id": existing["goal_id"],
            "goal_count": self._goal_count(),
        }
    
    # First submission
    goal_id = self._create_goal_id()
    snapshot = {
        "goal_id": goal_id,
        "submit_key": submit key,
        "title": title,
        "desired_outcome": desired_outcome,
        "goal": goal,
        "tasks": tasks,
        "submit_fingerprint": fingerprint,
        "created_at": datetime.utcnow(),
    }
    self._store_goal(snapshot)
    return {
        "ok": True ,
        "goal_id": goal_id,
        "goal_count": self._goal_count(),
    }
```

```python
def validate_plan_revision(self, plan: dict, goal_contract: dict = None) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Validate plan revision against contract ceiling."""
    # Extract contract
    contract = goal_contract or self.goal_contract or {}
    
    # Budget check
    if plan.get("budget"):
        budget = plan["budget"]
        if not contract.get("budget"):
            return False, "plan expands Goal contract budget"
        for k in ("wall_sec", "max_reworks", "max_lead_calls", "max_attempts", "max_usage"):
            if k in budget and k in contract["budget"]:
                if float(budget[k]) > float(contract["budget"][k]):
                    return False, "plan expands Goal contract budget"
    
    # Boundaries allow_* check
    boundaries = plan.get("boundaries", {})
    for key in ("allow_paths", "allow_secret_globs", "allow_keys"):
        if key in boundaries:
            new_items = set(boundaries[key])
            ceiling_items = set(contract.get("boundaries", {}).get(key, []))
            if not new_items.issubset(ceiling_items):
                return False, "plan expands Goal contract boundaries"
    
    return True, "ready"
```
